prompt.text: Re-encode regulation 4 of the Accident Compensation (Earners' Levy) Regulations 2025 (NZ) as a rulespec/v1 YAML module, working ONLY from the pinned axiom-corpus release nz-rulespec-2026-07-20's official PCO statute XML (data/corpus/sources/nz/regulation/2026-06-16-rulespec-nz-pco/regulation/public/2025/0018/wholeof.xml, provision id LMS1019194, citation path nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4). Never read the rulespec-nz project's published encoding of the same provision at any point during encoding. Learn the rulespec/v1 schema only from the repository's own documentation (.axiom/repository-structure.yaml, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, docs/axiom-ecosystem-integration.md) and from exemplar rule files for unrelated provisions (Wellington supermarket zoning, childcare assistance, student allowances, community services card).

output:
format: rulespec/v1
module:
  summary: |-
    Accident Compensation (Earners' Levy) Regulations 2025 (SL 2025/18),
    regulation 4 — the amount of earners' levy payable under section 219(1) of
    the Accident Compensation Act 2001 to fund the Earners' Account.

    Regulation 4 sets a standard levy rate, expressed in dollars per $100 of
    earnings, for three successive tax-year bands: $1.45 for the 2025/26 tax
    year (reg 4(1)(a)), $1.52 for the 2026/27 tax year (reg 4(2)(a)), and
    $1.59 for the 2027/28 tax year and any later tax year (reg 4(3)(a)).
    New Zealand personal tax years run 1 April to 31 March, and the
    regulations come into force on 1 April 2025 (reg 2), so the three rate
    versions take effect 2025-04-01, 2026-04-01, and 2027-04-01, with the
    third open-ended ("and any later tax year").

    For self-employed persons the regulation routes away from the standard
    rate: where regulation 7 applies (agreement with the Corporation to
    purchase weekly compensation), the levy is the amount calculated under
    reg 7(2)/(4)/(6) for the respective tax year (reg 4(1)(c), 4(2)(c),
    4(3)(c)); where regulation 6 applies but regulation 7 does not (worked
    more than an average of 30 hours per week and earned below the specified
    amount), the levy is the amount calculated under reg 6(2)/(4)/(6)
    (reg 4(1)(b), 4(2)(b), 4(3)(b)). This module encodes the routing as a
    derived selector; the regulation 6 and regulation 7 formulas themselves
    belong to their own provisions and are out of scope here.

    Reg 4(4) makes subclauses (1) to (3) subject to regulation 5 (maximum
    amount of earnings on which the levy is payable). The reg 5 caps are a
    separate provision and are not encoded in this module. Levy amounts are
    exclusive of GST (reg 8, context note only).

    Provenance: encoded directly from the official PCO XML ingested in the
    corpus as snapshot 2026-06-16-rulespec-nz-pco, source file
    sources/nz/regulation/2026-06-16-rulespec-nz-pco/regulation/public/2025/0018/wholeof.xml
    (sha256
    f675c8ac89dab2ed08c6e228b93c90c65f0d9aa29425a783790f08599ef0f574),
    provision id LMS1019194. Every excerpt below is a verbatim substring of
    the ingested provision text.
  proof_validation:
    required: true
  source_verification:
    corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
units:
  - name: NZD
    kind: currency
    minor_units: 2
rules:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Parameter: the standard earners' levy rate, in dollars of levy per $100 of
  # earnings, as reg 4 states it. Three effective-date versions, one per
  # tax-year band; the 2027/28 value continues for later tax years until
  # amended. Applies to all earners except those routed to the regulation 6 or
  # regulation 7 formulas.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: acc_earners_levy_rate_per_100_earnings
    kind: parameter
    dtype: Money
    unit: NZD
    source: >-
      Accident Compensation (Earners' Levy) Regulations 2025, reg 4(1)(a),
      4(2)(a), and 4(3)(a); commencement date from reg 2
    metadata:
      proof:
        atoms:
          - path: versions[0].formula
            kind: parameter
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "$1.45 per $100 of earnings"
          - path: versions[0].effective_from
            kind: parameter
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/2
              excerpt: "These regulations come into force on 1 April 2025"
          - path: versions[1].formula
            kind: parameter
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "$1.52 per $100 of earnings"
          - path: versions[2].formula
            kind: parameter
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "$1.59 per $100 of earnings"
          - path: versions[2].effective_from
            kind: parameter
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "The amount of earners’ levy payable for the 2027/28 tax year, and any later tax year"
    versions:
      - effective_from: '2025-04-01'
        formula: |-
          1.45
      - effective_from: '2026-04-01'
        formula: |-
          1.52
      - effective_from: '2027-04-01'
        formula: |-
          1.59
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Derived: which calculation method reg 4 routes an earner to. Reg 4 gives
  # the regulation 7 formula to self-employed persons with a weekly
  # compensation purchase agreement, the regulation 6 formula to self-employed
  # persons within its hours/earnings gate when regulation 7 does not apply,
  # and the standard per-$100 rate to everyone else. The two applicability
  # judgments are inputs supplied by encodings of regulations 6 and 7.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - name: acc_earners_levy_calculation_method
    kind: derived
    entity: Person
    dtype: Text
    period: Year
    source: >-
      Accident Compensation (Earners' Levy) Regulations 2025, reg 4(1)(b)-(c),
      4(2)(b)-(c), and 4(3)(b)-(c)
    metadata:
      proof:
        atoms:
          - path: versions[0].formula
            kind: formula
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "for self-employed persons to whom regulation 7 applies"
          - path: versions[0].formula
            kind: formula
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "for self-employed persons to whom regulation 6 applies (but regulation 7 does not apply)"
          - path: versions[0].formula
            kind: formula
            source:
              corpus_citation_path: nz/regulation/regulation/public/2025/0018/regulation/4
              excerpt: "for all earners, except those described in paragraphs (b) and (c)"
    versions:
      - effective_from: '2025-04-01'
        formula: |-
          if acc_earners_levy_regulation_7_applies:
              "regulation 7 formula"
          elif acc_earners_levy_regulation_6_applies:
              "regulation 6 formula"
          else:
              "standard rate"
